description: melanoma sentinel node, subcapsular deposit 0.4 mm
report:
Lymph node, right groin, sentinel lymph node biopsy

Received in formalin is a piece of fibroadipose tissue containing one lymph node. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Lymph node, bisected.

Sections show fibroadipose tissue and one lymph node. The lymph node is involved by metastatic malignant melanoma in the subcapsular sinus, the largest deposit measuring 0.4 mm. There is no extranodal extension. The tumour cells are highlighted by immunostain for SOX10.

LYMPH NODE, right groin, sentinel lymph node biopsy - METASTATIC MALIGNANT MELANOMA (1/1); largest deposit 0.4 mm; subcapsular; no extranodal extension
